name: Alley Danger
title: Tricky Story
steps: Beads Out Walkthrough [All Levels] – NEW UPDATE
Perfume Spray: Spray perfume → stun thug.
Banana Peel: Place peel → thug slips.
Overheating Vent: Short AC → sparks scare him.
Cardboard Box Helper: Open box → homeless man grabs thug.
Shattered Window: Break window → alley goes dark.
Scaredy Mouse: Drag mouse → thug panics.
Stray Cat: Tap cat → jumps on thug’s face.
Wig Blow Away: Use fan → wig flies off.
Hong Kong Kick: Girl kicks thug backward.
Classmate Wake Up: Tap boy → he wakes and escapes.
